title: Blade Spin Survivor
description: Surround your hero with orbiting razors, axes, and plasma saws—weave into packed monster swarms to shred waves in ultra-satisfying circular bursts.
controls: Drag anywhere to steer your hero around the arena, collect blades and gems, and shred incoming hordes.

zh-CN.title: 旋转大师割草
zh-CN.description: 极致解压肉鸽割草旋转大师：一圈飞刀大斧环绕高速旋转，钻进怪堆瞬间切瓜砍菜满屏掉宝爽到飞起！
zh-CN.controls: 按住拖动虚拟摇杆控制走位，用环绕旋转飞刀收割全场怪潮并拾取升级道具。
